description: This file defines the NotesListViewModel class for managing the UI logic related to a list of notes in an Android application. It uses Kotlin coroutines and Flow to handle reactive data streams from a NotesRepository, providing a LiveData/StateFlow-based interface for the UI to observe note data, with search query support.

classes.name: NotesListViewModel
classes.description: ViewModel responsible for managing and providing a list of notes to the UI, including search functionality.

methods.name: setQuery
methods.description: Updates the search query text which triggers the data stream to update the list of notes.
